# Digital Marketing Bureau

> India-based digital marketing agency led by Parmjeet Singh. Services include SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, landing pages and measurement. Public information is available in English.

## Business information
- Website: https://dmbureau.cloud
- Email: connect@dmbureau.cloud
- Phone: +91 94101 74200
- Delivery: based in India; serving India, US, UK, UAE, Dubai and Kuwait. Country pages do not imply offices in those locations.
- Work and fees are agreed before starting. No guaranteed rankings, sales, AI citations or performance scores.
